title: Hot Cross Buns
lead: A London street cry: bakers sang it to sell hot spiced buns on Good Friday.
time_html:
Count 1 2 in every bar, steady as a clock: two beats a bar.

Walk on a beat; run two quick notes in one beat: say pen-ny, count 1 +.
pos:
Your hand. Right hand: finger 2 on middle C, 3 on D, 4 on E: the three middle fingers.

Steps down. E, D, C: each note is the next key down, and on the page each sits a step lower.
sing_how: Listen, pointing to each note. Sing it with the words, then on the letter names.
names_how: Now the notes are empty. Write E, D or C in each box, then sing it on the letter names.
more_how: The same three keys, a new way: a robot that walks with the band. Then make a tune of your own.
wow: Your first song with a band. Three notes, and you are already playing with drums and bass: scan the code, choose the band, and play on top. Then open your passport: Lesson 1 issues it.
trick: One note here is wrong. Play it, then the same bars on page 1: which note sounds wrong? Circle it.

yours.how: Pick one and play the whole song that way. Record it on a phone and listen back: does it sound the way you meant?
pick: Robot: every note short and stiff
Giant: slow and heavy, big footsteps

menu: As a giant, then a mouse
rhy_how: Say the words in time, then clap and count: clap on the coral numbers, hold through the grey ones.

v2.name: Three steps down
v2.pat_how: E, D, C: each note is the next key down. Learn it once, and you will find it all through this book.
v2.hand: Your hand. Right hand: 4 on E, 3 on D, 2 on middle C.
v2.sing_how: Listen and point to each note. Sing it with the words, then play it. The coral names above are for the band.
v2.p2_how: Everything here uses the song on page 1: no new music to read.
v2.spot: On page 1, draw the pattern sign over every E D C.
v2.clap: Say the words of page 1 in time, then clap them: walk is one beat, run-ning is two quick halves, hold is two beats.
v2.fix: Write the letter names in the boxes. One note is not the same as page 1: circle it, then play the bars the right way.
v2.p3_how: Your left hand rests in Lessons 1 and 2: the band plays the names. Your right hand takes the pattern somewhere new.
v2.names: The coral names above the song tell the band what to play. This song has only two, and the name changes just once: find the G.
v2.move_how: The same three steps down, from another key: the same fingers, 4 3 2.
steps: Play the song with the band
Say the names in time while the band plays: C, C, C, C, C, G, C, C
Play Hot Cross Buns from G (G F E): a new place, the same song
v2.seen: Seen before: three steps down. How many can you find?
v2.yours: Play Hot Cross Buns as a giant (slow and heavy) or a mouse (fast and tiny).
